versions.changelog: Tightened local delivery so explicit local-output requests must write files to disk. Changed bundle layout to project/<delivery-slug>/... instead of writing directly under project/. Updated the contract so project/, project/<delivery-slug>/, and project/<delivery-slug>/image/ are created automatically before saving assets.

Changed local delivery root to project/. Added dynamic activity-generation and animation choreography contracts. Strengthened photorealistic hero-image quality gates and fixed Python local output creation for project/ and project/image/.
Added a stricter hero-image contract, fixed delivery asset handoff to ./image/bg.png, and raised the festive front-end finish bar.
Added a mandatory image-generation gate with regenerate_each_run behavior, direct image_generate guidance when available, and blocked-on-failure handling for image-required briefs.
Defaulted poster-led delivery/full outputs to a real top-of-page image.png hero visual with reference-driven background treatment.
Added female-led hero defaults, tab-first H5 delivery, launch-ready quality rules, and optional local Python artifact generation for proposal and delivery flows.
Removed executable save-command generation and switched to plain-language file handoff rules.
Initial ClawHub release with marketplace UI metadata and source homepage.
